verified.notes: Installed from the packed tarball into a disposable isolated non-Desktop profile, composed with --dump-config, booted with a bounded real startup, exercised over the authenticated /api transport, generated one real image through the live Agnes API, downloaded its bytes through the media route, verified the record and artifact survive a restart, and verified deletion removes both. The Client half was then driven in a real headless Chrome against the owned DSH Web app over CDP (scripts/ui-check.mjs), with two deterministic image records seeded into the owned data directory (scripts/seed-fixture.mjs) so the gallery and viewer could be exercised without network, credentials or quota: the sidebar entry selects the studio page, the panel renders without a console error, the two-pane body is measured to be two columns side by side with the composer not spanning the panel, the parameter controls render their model-derived values in the shape their option count calls for (a segmented control for four resolutions, chips for eight ratios), the Flash video model narrows the resolution list to 720P, the generate button is measured to sit inside the viewport rather than below the fold, a disabled primary is verified to drop the gradient and stay opaque, the gallery renders its cards in a uniform 4:3 crop, the category filter is verified to change the rendered results, both themes are measured to change the panel's surface and text colours, and the image viewer opens in-panel, covers the whole viewport with no containing-block trap, zooms by a measured layout change rather than a label, closes on Escape and on a backdrop click, does not close when the picture itself is clicked, steps through the gallery with the arrow keys while resetting the zoom per picture, and returns focus to the control that opened it. Evidence: docs/evidence/isolated-mount-0.2.0.json, docs/evidence/browser-ui-check.json and docs/evidence/screenshots/. Cleanup verified: owned roots removed, all processes stopped.
